game.label: 21 Black Hole game
game.modeProof: AI uses the proven first-player winning strategy
game.modeExperimental: Experimental strong defense · no proof that the second player can avoid losing
game.rulesOne: Players take turns placing their own numbers from 1 to 10 into empty cells. The final empty cell becomes the black hole; only its neighbors are scored.
game.rulesTwo: The player with the larger neighboring sum loses; equal sums are a draw. Blue moves first and red moves second.
game.resultHole: The black hole is cell {cell}; highlighted circles contribute to the score.

proof.title: First player wins. No guessing.
proof.subtitle: The strategy certificate supplies witnesses for the first four moves; exact alpha–beta search solves every leaf to the end.
proof.coverTitle: Fix H1=1 and cover every opponent reply.
proof.coverBody: H denotes the certificate-guided first player and A an arbitrary opponent. The opponent has 20 possible first moves. For each one, the certificate selects a single H2 that covers every later reply, then supplies H3 and H4.
proof.caveat: The JSON is a strategy witness and computation record, not a formal proof tree that can be checked without computation. An independent reviewer must rerun the public proof program to confirm every exact endgame result.
proof.integrityBody: Every build checks this SHA-256 and validates the completeness and legality of all 20 × 18 × 16 mappings.
proof.sourceLink: View the source certificate and verifier ↗
proof.explorerBody: From this H4 position, the verifier searched every continuation to the end and confirmed that the first player can force a win.
